answer_form: AssignProblem: one variable per vertex, options = colours, n_opts = largest degree + 1 (instance data, always suffices), a colour may be taken any number of times (capacity None, not ordered). Groups: [0] soft, number of colours in use (the published value for a complete answer); [1] hard, number of edges with both ends assigned the same colour. One var_var relation (0/1 adjacency), no attribute columns. Restriction: proper colourings with more than largest degree + 1 colours are outside the form (dominated answers only).
groups: 7 groups: LEI 12, MYC 5, REG 8, SGB-book 4, SGB-game 1, SGB-miles 5, SGB-queen 8 (source code printed on the page; SGB divided into the page's four kinds)
hosts_used: none in this session (data already pinned from mat.tepper.cmu.edu by the manifest; no new download)
instances_left_out: 36 of the page's 79: 21 only in binary .col.b; 8 where the page prints '?' (no reference); 4 with more than 500 vertices (inithx.i.1-3, homer); 3 with vertices x (largest degree + 1) above 100,000 (fpsol2.i.1-3). Unchanged by this correction.
reference: The chromatic number printed beside each instance on the pinned page instances.html; attainable by an answer of the form (always below largest degree + 1). The builder holds a colouring with that number for 39 of 43 instances; for le450_15c, le450_15d, le450_25c, le450_25d it rests on the page alone.
score_scale: Plain ratio min(1, page's number / colours used); 0 for a conflict or a malformed answer. Chosen because random valid answers average 0.30 on it over all instances (0.32 on the fresh set), below 0.5, and because the alternative zero (expected value of a uniformly random valid colouring) cannot be computed exactly. Stated limit: on games120, miles500, miles1500 and myciel3 no answer of the form can score below 0.51 to 0.68.
source: Graph Coloring Instances page of M. Trick, https://mat.tepper.cmu.edu/COLOR/instances.html, DIMACS text .col files; page pinned by SHA-256 as the reference source
threshold_and_anchor: threshold 0.95 (was 0.90). Anchor: an operating point, not an external fact, set knowing that a rule with no search (first-fit in a random vertex order) scores 0.89 on the fresh instances and knowing no learner result: a mean ratio of the chromatic number printed on the instance page to the colours used of 0.95, which is between one and two colours too many on every queen graph with the rest exact (0.965 and 0.937); the queen graphs carry the signal, the other fresh graphs are nearly solved by first-fit, and the confirming half holds almost no headroom (first-fit 0.986 there).
